steps.text: Paste a Duels.ink log or replay into this field, or drop the file on the page. The Dojo works out what it is.

text.desktop: No game to hand? Press **A Duels.ink log** for an example.
text.phone: No game to hand? Tap **A Duels.ink log** for an example.

steps.text: The readout says what it found: a Duels.ink log and how many turns it has.

text.desktop: Press **Study this game**. In the tour it opens as a practice board, so nothing goes in your library.
text.phone: Tap **Study this game**. In the tour it opens as a practice board, so nothing goes in your library.

steps.text: Every turn of the game is now a node. Open the **Multiverse** to see them.
Here's the game turn by turn. Select a node and **Play from here** to replay it. Cards the log never names stay unknown until you fill them in.
